# UX/UI & Workflow Checklist: Path-Based Risk Analytics & Trusted Extraction

**Purpose**: Comprehensive validation of UX/UI requirements quality for risk panels, provenance interaction, and PDF export.
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all possible states (Found, Inferred, Missing, Conflict, User-Supplied) visually distinct and defined for Field Provenance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Are empty and loading states fully specified for the Monte Carlo simulation delay? [Completeness, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the modal layout and interactions for session-only branding inputs fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec define the exact visual layout for a "Conflict" state showing contradictory texts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the "progressive disclosure" behavior (Advanced toggle) quantified with specific interaction rules? [Clarity, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK006 Are "vibrant harmonious palettes" and "glassmorphism accents" defined with exact design tokens or measurable properties? [Clarity, Const §III]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the layout order for the exported PDF explicitly mandated and unambiguous? [Clarity, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK008 Are debouncing rules for complex simulations consistently applied across all input sliders? [Consistency, Const §III]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do the Compare mode UI requirements align consistently with the single-product view UI requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the UI treatment of "Missing" and "Conflict" fields consistent in blocking the export workflow? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can the 5-second simulation feedback limit be objectively measured under various network conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the 10-second export limit testable with specific file size or DOM complexity assumptions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are UI requirements defined for handling user inputs of 100,000+ paths without freezing the browser? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for when the user attempts to export while analytics are marked stale? [Exception Flow, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the UI error messaging specified when termsheet extraction fails entirely? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for UI rendering of PII redaction (e.g., masking vs. deletion)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033]
